sources.title: A competitive disinhibitory network for robust optic flow processing in Drosophila
supports: Recurrent inhibition and lateral disinhibition contribute to rotation-versus-translation processing.
DNp15 GABA-A manipulation is less specific than removing bIPS outputs.

sources.title: Bilateral interactions of optic-flow sensitive neurons coordinate course control in flies
supports: Bilateral electrical interactions and chemical connections in the HS-H2 system contribute to course control.

sources.title: A faithful internal representation of walking movements in the Drosophila visual system
supports: HS activity contains nonvisual walking-related information as well as visual signals.
